subject: planner: extend predicate simplification for subquery and nested expressions (#58261)
summary:
Reviewed planner changes in `pkg/planner/core/rule_predicate_simplification.go` and `pkg/planner/core/rule_decorrelate.go`.

- Extends predicate simplification with logical constant handling (True/False), recursive short-circuiting for nested `AND`/`OR`, and post-simplification CNF splitting; guards plan-cache safety via `MaybeOverOptimized4PlanCache` and marks `StmtCtx` skip-plan-cache when triggered.
- Adds `pruneRedundantApply` in `DecorrelateSolver` to remove `LogicalSelection` + `LogicalApply` when predicates simplify to always-TRUE, preventing execution of decorrelated subqueries in short-circuited branches (e.g. `TRUE OR EXISTS(...)`).

Checked minimal surrounding call-chain/behavior around Apply/Join schema/column-pruning and EXISTS rewrite (`logical_apply.go`, `logical_join.go`, `expression_rewriter.go`) to validate the transformation’s safety within the intended patterns. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness or SQL semantics within scope.
